title: Rest where attachment cannot rule
summary: The line loosens the hand without asking the heart to go cold. Let this stay near the next choice: keep this in front of you: steadiness grows where attachment loses its authority.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: When praise, slander, or comparison starts moving your mood, step back from the screen or doorway and say the line once. Let sanctuary steady what possession cannot.

source.shortMeaning: Peace begins when refuge matters more than possession or praise.
source.lifeApplication: When the grip tightens, move the heart toward refuge before reaction.
